claims: The Czech Republic is located in Central Europe.
The Czech Republic is a parliamentary republic.
Prague is the capital city of the Czech Republic.
The Czech Republic was established in 1993 after the dissolution of Czechoslovakia.
The Czech Republic is a member of the EU.
The Czech Republic is a member of NATO.
The Czech Republic uses the Czech Koruna (CZK) as its currency.
The official language of the Czech Republic is Czech.
Prague is the largest city of the Czech Republic.
The major cities of the Czech Republic are Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Pilsen, and Liberec.
The Czech Republic is landlocked.
The Czech Republic borders Germany, Austria, Slovakia, and Poland.
The Czech Republic is part of the Schengen Area.
U.S. citizens do not need a visa for short-term stays up to 90 days in the Czech Republic for tourism or business purposes.
A passport valid for at least three months beyond the intended departure from the Schengen area is required for entry to the Czech Republic.
Český Krumlov is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
The Czech Republic was formed on January 1, 1993.
The Czech Republic was formed following the peaceful Velvet Divorce from Slovakia.
The Velvet Divorce dissolved Czechoslovakia.
